_comment: Register the AMC-CE turret editor as an MCP server. Copy the 'amc-turret-editor'
entry into your client's config: Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json),
Claude Code (.mcp.json), Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json), Antigravity or any other
stdio MCP client. Replace the absolute path with your own checkout.
The mod root is resolved from the script's own location, so no working
directory is needed. The two env vars are optional overrides: point them at a
copy of the mod if you want the AI to experiment without touching your files.
